profile.name: Ravi Singh
profile.headline: Software Development Engineer
profile.intro: I’m a software engineer working across payments, data platforms, and developer tools. I like making complex systems faster, safer, and easier to operate.
profile.about: From reducing payment latency at Amazon to building data workflows at Oracle, I enjoy taking complicated systems and making them more dependable. Outside of work, I’m exploring local-first AI with SearchLocal: a private desktop search agent grounded in the files you already own.

highlights.text: Led a low-latency optimistic fulfillment path for Tier-1 payment flows, reducing transaction latency from 24.7s to 8.6s.
Led 2FA suppression for Add Money and Pay Orders across BOSON and DPOD orders, avoiding redundant authentication after primary flight transaction verification.
Built configurable kill switches for optimistic fulfillment, supporting real-time policy enforcement, safeguards, rollback, and on-call awareness.
Contributed to a plugin-based digital ordering pipeline for UPI orders and configurable AWS resources, reducing fulfillment latency to 6 seconds.
Led backend integration of the simplified Thunderbolt payment page for Amazon NOW customers.
Contributed fixes for the Bento Theme and Amrut app to improve customer experience.
Designed modules that generate YAML from table metadata for data streaming and replication, cutting metadata extraction time by 60% and removing an Oracle Data Integrator dependency.
Implemented PySpark APIs for deduplication and compaction; added unit tests for four housekeeping tasks including vacuuming and garbage collection.
Automated ODP configuration updates by embedding required parameters, improving replication workflow efficiency and accuracy by over 50%.
Migrated 3,800 table definitions from Oracle Data Integrator to YAML for CDP and GCW environments.

projects.name: SearchLocal
projects.summary: A local-first Mac search agent that indexes text files into SQLite FTS5 and retrieves useful snippets for natural-language questions.
projects.details: SearchLocal uses a local language model through Ollama to generate answers grounded in retrieved file context, with cited paths and source chunks.

projects.name: JobSearch-Assistant
projects.summary: A local job-search workspace with an Excel-backed company watchlist, application pipeline, configurable follow-up reminders, and per-role activity timelines. Its Search Copilot uses Ollama models with read-only MCP tools to answer questions about tracked companies, applications, and follow-ups.
projects.details: Built with Python, Ollama, and MCP. The model runs locally; its MCP server exposes read-only tracker tools, so the copilot can retrieve context without changing application records. The Excel workbook remains editable and importable as the tracker’s local persistence layer.
